spans.s: Before the Aorist-characteristic स् (सिच्), वृद्धि is substituted in the परस्मैपद for the final of a अङ्ग (stem) ending in इ , उ , ऋ (long or short -- इको गुणवृद्धी

The इट् is not lengthened after वॄ , वृञ् and after roots ending in long ॠ in the s-Aorist of the परस्मैपद ।

Terms: इट् augment

The ष् substitution does not take place in the स् of सिच् of the Intensive.

Terms: षत्व change
